_about: T660/T662 item E (owner 2026-11-11): NAMED blue lines lying wholly inside the DFO tidal-waters polygon on the live atlas (every 10 m sample of every section inside; lines already wholly tidal excluded). The proposed rule takes every such line off the freshwater map; unnamed ones go without asking, these wait for the owner. Set `remove` to true or false per row. Maps: T660-shots/inside-named-01..09.png (alphabetical, same order). Nothing is applied. Most rows are side channels of a named river whose curated tidal limit is `mouth` (the river stays freshwater to its mouth): removing them makes the channel tidal while the main channel beside it stays freshwater.
